When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.

2586-4050-7690--165.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.

728-3249-4289-5553.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-5553.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

240-969-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1453-4153-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

2446-3259-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

670-804-1619-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Gigantoplasm and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

862-1927-4336-6516.description:

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

215-4068-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
215-4068-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5256-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

514-654-3967-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

323-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4476-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1021-4050-5226-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-4050-5226-6761.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-4050-5226-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

1238-2351-4452-5147-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

2921-4275-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
2921-4275-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2034-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2034-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4509-5641-5783.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying and vigilance due to Divine Visitation..
When the Angel enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

864-1312-2034-3480-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1965-4316-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Omarthis on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1883-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
1031-1883-4821.description:
Activate all mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Invasion of Arcavios.
Replication Technique's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it, with your copy targeting Invasion of Arcavios.
Resolve  your copy of Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Invasion of Arcavios.
When the token Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dramatic Reversal to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the original Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Invasion of Arcavios.
When the token Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Replication Technique to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}, you may earn infinite mana, and then target any other permanent using the copy of Replication Technique.

1636-2370-4050-4649-4772.notablePrerequisites: Tempting Licid does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2370-4050-4649-4772.description:
Activate Tempting Licid by tapping it and paying {G}, attaching it to Bramble Elemental.
Bramble Elemental triggers, creating four Saproling creature tokens.
Intruder Alarm triggers four times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing a Saproling creature token, adding {G} each time.
Pay {G} to end Tempting Licid's effect, making it a creture once more.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
Sacrifice any number of Saproling creature tokens for infinite mana in any combination of colors.
